## About
Sage Auto Repair is a complete care and repair shop in the heart of Columbia Heights. We live in the community, work in the community and serve the community. We also support local teachers and classrooms with supplies, because we're invested and here to stay.
When your car comes in, our Master Technicians get to the source of the problem before anything expensive gets replaced. You get an estimate so you can make an informed decision, and if all you need is something simple, we'll tell you.
Our customers have given us 4.6 stars across 247 Google reviews. One reviewer summed it up as "Genuine neighborhood service," and that's what we try to be.

## Services
- Diagnostics & service: Hard starting, rough running, mystery noises, fluid leaks or warning lights. We pinpoint the issue before replacing anything.
- Engine & transmission repairs: Check engine lights, overheating, timing belts, transmission operation and fluid service, plus engine rebuilding.
- Oil changes & maintenance: Oil changes, fluid checks and changes, belts, battery, bulbs and wipers to keep your car running smooth.
- Tires, alignment & brakes: Tire repair, rotation, balancing and new tires, along with brake pads, rotors, hydraulics and anti-lock brakes.
- Air conditioning: Leaks, compressor issues, clogged filters, cooling fans or radiator trouble. If it's just a recharge, we'll let you know.
- Battery, alternator & starter: Clicking when you should be revving? We check the battery, alternator and the rest of your car's electrical pathway.
- Pre-purchase inspections: Thinking about buying a used car? Have us look it over first.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: Yes. Our mechanics are qualified to work on any car, make and model, and we handle trucks too.

Q: Can I get a loaner car?
A: Yes, we offer a loaner car to our customers.

Q: Do you have a car-care credit card?
A: Yes. You can apply for the Sage Auto Repair car-care credit card, which comes with 6 months interest-free.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 4239 Central Avenue Northeast, Columbia Heights, MN 55421.
